messages:
Nina: FYI — HarborLine procurement insists on an invoice for a 60-day Dedicated pilot. AE asks for 24% off list. PO will arrive today. Can finance approve invoicing at that rate?
Omar: What's the $ math and any conversion signal? 24% is above our standard pilot band.
Nina: List is $40k/mo; 24% off = $30.4k/mo -> $60.8k total for 2 months. No commit in PO; customer cites competitor offer.
Felix: Deal-desk rule: discounts >20% require RevOps + CFO sign-off. Also request tagging invoices with "pilot_special" code for reporting.
Rhea: Legal: if approved, add SOW addendum limiting pilot to 60 days and a clause that any committed pricing requires a new agreement. Also include data segregation language.
BillingBot: Draft invoice INV-2026-0620 created for $30,400/month. Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0620
Omar: Margin note: at 24% margin is still OK but risky if usage spikes. Suggest daily token cap (e.g., 160k/day) or auto-reprice beyond cap. Can AE get that into PO?
Nina: AE will push for cap and auto-reprice clause; procurement prefers plain invoice but may accept simple terms amendment.
CFO_Claire: I can approve up to 20% pilot discount for up to 90 days if: 1) token cap or auto-reprice is in place, 2) invoice tagged for analytics, 3) Legal SOW addendum signed. For 24% we need Exec Rev Ops sign-off; escalate with regional impact and projected ACV conversion.
Felix: I'll prepare the billing tag and reconciliation cadence once we have the PO.
Nina: Escalating to RevOps now with ACV thesis and EMEA priority. Will update when PO amendment is uploaded. :thumbsup:
